name: linear
description: Work with Linear issues from Kettu. Mention them in a message, see them as references in replies, give agents tools to search, read, create and comment on issues, and list the issues assigned to you.

description.en: Work with Linear issues from Kettu. Mention them in a message, see them as references in replies, give agents tools to search, read, create and comment on issues, and list the issues assigned to you.
description.zh-CN: 在消息里引用 Linear issue，在回复里把它们显示为引用，让智能体搜索、阅读、创建 issue 并评论，还能在会话旁列出分配给你的 issue。

settings.title: Personal API key
settings.description: Create one in Linear under Settings › Security & access. It is sent to api.linear.app and nowhere else. The tools that create and comment need a key that may write.

settings.title: Default team (optional)
settings.description: The key of the team new issues go to when the agent names none, such as ENG.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Searches Linear issues by words, or finds one by its identifier such as ENG-123. Answers one line per issue with its identifier, state, title and team.

query.description: Words to search for, or an issue identifier such as ENG-123.

limit.description: How many issues to answer with, 10 by default.

tools.name: read_issue
tools.description: Reads one Linear issue: its state, priority, team, assignee, labels, description and its newest comments.

id.description: The issue's identifier such as ENG-123, or the address of the issue on linear.app.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Creates a Linear issue in a team and answers with its identifier and address.

team.description: The key of the team, such as ENG. The default team from the plugin settings when left out.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to a Linear issue and answers with the comment's address.

id.description: The issue's identifier such as ENG-123, or the address of the issue on linear.app.

description.zh-CN: 分配给你、尚未完成的 issue。
